errors.text_span: mit gleichmäßigen Intervallen von einem Jahr
errors.evidence: The tick marks on the x-axis are at 6-month intervals (e.g., 07/2014, 01/2015, 07/2015), not one-year intervals.

errors.text_span: Die linke y-Achse ist mit „monatlich“ beschriftet
errors.evidence: The left y-axis is labeled "Mrd. US-$". The label "monatlich (linke Achse)" refers to the purple line data series, not the axis itself.

errors.text_span: die von 0 bis 200 Milliarden US-Dollar reicht
errors.evidence: The scale of the left y-axis ranges from -50 to 200 billion US dollars, not from 0 to 200.

errors.text_span: Die rechte y-Achse ist mit „Summe der zurückliegenden zwölf Monate“ beschriftet
errors.evidence: The right y-axis is labeled "Mrd. US-$". The label "Summe der zurückliegenden zwölf Monate (rechte Achse)" refers to the blue line data series, not the axis itself.

errors.text_span: schwankt dann bis etwa 110 Milliarden US-Dollar im Dezember 2019
errors.evidence: In the period before 2020, the purple line fluctuates mostly between 50 and 100 billion US dollars; it never reaches 110 billion.

errors.text_span: fällt auf etwa 40 Milliarden US-Dollar im Februar 2020
errors.evidence: The sharp dip in the purple line around early 2020 goes down to a negative value, approximately -20 billion US dollars, not 40 billion.

errors.text_span: steigt bis 2023 auf etwa 170 Milliarden US-Dollar
errors.evidence: The purple line peaks around 180 billion US dollars in mid-2022, not in 2023. In 2023, the values are generally lower than this peak.

errors.text_span: beginnend bei etwa 1.200 Milliarden US-Dollar im Juli 2014
errors.evidence: The blue line starts at approximately 1,000 billion US dollars in July 2014, not 1,200.

errors.text_span: schwankt bis etwa 1.600 Milliarden US-Dollar im Dezember 2019
errors.evidence: In the period until mid-2020, the blue line is stable between approximately 900 and 1,000 billion US dollars; it does not approach 1,600 billion.

errors.text_span: fällt auf etwa 800 Milliarden US-Dollar im Februar 2020
errors.evidence: The blue line shows a very minor dip to approximately 900 billion US dollars in early 2020, not a fall to 800 billion.

errors.text_span: steigt bis etwa 1.800 Milliarden US-Dollar im Oktober 2021
errors.evidence: The blue line reaches approximately 1,500 billion US dollars in October 2021. It does not reach 1,800 billion until late 2022 / early 2023.
